# Accessible First-Person Navigation

When a 3D first-person game must meet WCAG and mobile requirements, treat the scene as an immersive context and provide equivalent semantic controls for every consequential workflow.

## What Happened
For Space-Mission-Design-Game task t5, the approved UX needed desktop pointer-lock movement, mobile touch, keyboard and screen-reader access, and all legacy mission activities. A parallel labeled activity map, DOM-based mission panels, explicit focus/route returns, and safe confirmations let users complete tasks without precise spatial aiming. [2026-11-03]

## Takeaway
Give each in-world station a named HTML equivalent; never make pointer lock, hover, color, drag precision, timed movement, or a complex touch gesture the only way to complete a mission action. Keep confirmed save state and mission outcomes explicit in both the scene and accessible UI.
